page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7a-nps1.8xlarge is a compute-optimized instance belonging to the ecs.c7a family. It is powered by an AMD EPYC 7T83 processor running at 2.55 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The server provides 32 dedicated physical cores with a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration, resulting in 32 vCPUs. It features 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core. No local storage or GPU hardware is bundled with this instance, and network connectivity is anchored by an 8 Gbps baseline bandwidth.

Benchmark data highlights strong single-core CPU performance, with stress-ng single-core tests placing in the top 25% at 2697.59. Multi-core performance is moderate, with stress-ng multi-core and PassMark CPU scores falling into the average range. Memory performance is robust, as indicated by a strong PassMark memory score in the top 25%, alongside average uncached read and write memory bandwidths of 83.67 GB/sec and 48.11 GB/sec respectively. Cryptographic capabilities are supported by hardware-accelerated AES and SHA instruction sets.

Given its dedicated core allocation and 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this instance offers a cost-efficient profile for compute-heavy workloads that do not require massive memory footprints. The lack of local storage requires reliance on network-attached storage, which is a key architectural tradeoff. This server is suited for compute-intensive tasks such as web serving, multi-threaded decompression, and moderate database operations.
